Game Overview

In Kingdom of Ninja 4, the core idea is straightforward: step into the pixelated world of Kingdom of Ninja 4, navigating 20 perilous levels. Master precise jumps and face dangerous foes as balls threaten instant demise. With strategic movement and timing on desktop or mobile, survival demands cunning and skillful combat in this nostalgic yet thrilling adventure.
